product_risk_or_requirement: We must know if this screening flow is high-risk under VN AI rules before applicants see it
current_state: I only have a student-level read of the law titles. No signed inventory or legal memo yet
product_requirement: Do not start the applicant-facing pilot until legal maps our workflow and vendor role to the AI Law and high-risk list
acceptance_criteria: Given the frozen product scope and Vietnam careers flow When we hold the pilot readiness review Then a signed classification memo and system inventory exist and match the release candidate
evidence_needed: Signed classification memo and AI system inventory

product_risk_or_requirement: Auto-reject is the harm I am most afraid of after reading iTutorGroup
current_state: We designed no auto-reject but have not proven the vendor config and UI cannot do it
product_requirement: The product must not finish a rejection without a named recruiter review a reason code and a visible appeal path
acceptance_criteria: Given a proposed rejection When the recruiter tries to finish it Then the system blocks unless review record reason code and appeal path exist and the auto-reject counter stays at zero
evidence_needed: Test log plus config export showing no auto-reject and a short appeal rehearsal note

product_risk_or_requirement: Ranking can still hide people even if reject stays human
current_state: I wrote a KRI but nobody independent has checked the dashboard or pause drill
product_requirement: Show a simple group dashboard and pause ranking if the gap is too large
acceptance_criteria: Given a 30-day complete-application set When weekly review runs Then we record selection-rate ratios and ranking pauses if the ratio is below 0.80 for a monitored group with n at least 30
deadline_or_trigger: First week of live ranking and before any model promotion
evidence_needed: Someone independent reviews the KRI sheet and a pause drill note

current_state: We do not yet have a signed list of what we collect why and which vendor stores it
product_requirement: Finish a personal-data inventory before the careers site sends files to ranking
acceptance_criteria: Given the live data flow When the privacy gate is reviewed Then purpose lawful basis retention vendor roles and applicant notice are signed and extra sensitive inference stays off
deadline_or_trigger: Before any applicant data goes to ranking
evidence_needed: Signed data inventory processing record and notice text

product_risk_or_requirement: Recruitment AI is high-risk if we offer it in the EU
current_state: EU is out of scope but I want the flag to stay off so we do not drift
product_requirement: Do not turn on EU applicants or recruiters in this release
acceptance_criteria: Given an EU tenant or market request When someone asks for release Then we refuse for this milestone and file a short memo instead of a go
deadline_or_trigger: Only if scope adds the EU
evidence_needed: Short memo that EU offer is disabled
